title: Infrastructure owner's output contract
description: The versioned output contract the infrastructure owner publishes and this repository consumes as inputs (spec 012 FR-002, FR-004, research R1). The owner composes the project, bootstrap, billing, APIs, IAM and state in its own repository; no state is read across this boundary. A contract version this repository does not support is refused by validation. Public copies hold synthetic values only.

version.description: The contract version; the funnel supports exactly this one.

project_id.description: The dedicated project's id, created from the infrastructure owner's reviewed plan; never an existing workload project.

region.description: The region every resource of the example lives in; the funnel refuses inputs that name another.

runtime_identity.description: The service identity the backend runs as; it holds no deploy or build permission.

build_identity.description: The identity Cloud Build runs as; it holds no runtime permission, and it is never the runtime identity.

artifact_registry.description: The repository the image is promoted into, by digest.

state_bucket.description: Named for the record only; this repository never reads it.
